en: A colorized historic view of a grand city square with a large neo‑Renaissance town hall building featuring a central dome and clock, corner towers, and ornate façades. In front of the building is a fountain or monument surrounded by statues and steps, with café tables and umbrellas in the square. Horse‑drawn carriages, early trams, and pedestrians move along wide streets lined with multistory buildings. At the top of the image, red text in German reads: "Graz, Hauptplatz mit Rathaus und Herrengasse".
